summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K with a press release providing a routine construction update on its cobalt sulfate refinery in Ontario. The update details progress on structural steel, concrete, equipment installation, and piping, and mentions finalized definitive construction agreements with WB Melback (approx. C$26M) and Pro Pipe Construction (approx. C$6.8M). No special-situation event such as an acquisition, strategic review, or capital action is disclosed. This is an ordinary operational progress report, not a special situation. What to watch: continued construction milestones and commissioning timelines.
